core_features: Speculative science or technology central to the premise
World shaped by advanced tech, space travel, AI, or altered biology
Exploration of consequences of technology or scientific ideas
typical_settings: Megacities dominated by corporations or systems
typical_conflicts: Ethical conflict around AI, cloning, surveillance, or transhumanism
protagonist_archetypes: Civilian caught in a massive technological event
tone_guidelines: Often thoughtful, tense, or awe-filled; can be optimistic, grim, or cautionary.

required_elements: At least one clearly described advanced technology or scientific concept that matters to the plot
A visible consequence (social or personal) of that technology or concept
At least one location that is clearly not a mundane present-day setting
forbidden_elements: Unexplained magic that ignores scientific framing (unless clearly framed as advanced tech or unknown physics)
